## Page 20

Business Outlook Year 2026
•New Asset Acquisition Plans :
-Approved the 5th Additional Investment 
and Capital Increase No. 3 (Unitholder 
Resolution on Jan 9, 2026)
-Asset Value Milestone: Total Asset 
Value projected to exceed Baht 14,000 
Million .
-Long -term Sustainability: Extended 
average Leasehold period to 28 years, 
ensuring stable and long -term 
distributions for unitholders.
-Prime Strategic Locations: Maintaining 
dominance in Thailand’s logistics 
heartland , including Bangna -Trad Road, 
Samut Prakan , and the EEC.
-Acquisition Source: Will the focus be on 
acquiring assets from the Sponsor 
(Prospect Development), and third -party.
Macroeconomic Factors, 
Thailand Industrial Real Estate 
Market Overview and Trends 
•Economic forecast by Ministry of Finance : 
-Thai GDP is forecast at 2.0% in 2026 amid challenges from 
U.S. trade retaliation measures, a high -base effect from the 
2025 export surge, and political uncertainty may lead to further 
delays in public sector budget disbursements.
•BOI Investment Summary (Y2025 ):
-BOI applications hit an all -time high since inception, with 3,370 
projects (+11%) and total investment of 1,876,653 million Baht
(+67%).
-FDIcontinues to expand with 2,421 projects (+21%), totaling  
1,359,925 million Baht (+66 %).
-Investor Confidence: Driven by Thailand’s readiness for High -
Tech and Sustainable Green Industries, reflecting strong long -
term potential .
•Industrial real estate sector: 
-Experts (Knight Frank, CBRE, JLL) identify Industrial, Tourism, 
and Technology as high -growth segments for 2026.
-Positive impact on PROSPECT REIT’s core portfolio, aligned 
with industry trends.
-Target Asset Classes: High demand for Ready -Built Factories, 
Built-to-Suit, Warehouses, and Data Centers.
-Strategic Hubs: Growth concentrated in Bangna –Trad, EEC, 
Rangsit –Pathum Thani , and Wang Noi–Ayutthaya.Investment and 
Growth Strategy
•Occupancy Rate, Renewal Rate, and 
Rental Rate :
-Maintaining high occupancy rates above 
95%, and high renewal rates above 90%. 
-Future rental rate adjustments are 
expected to align with market conditions 
and inflation.
•Revenue Projection:
-Following the 5th Additional Investment , 
total revenue for 2026 is projected to 
grow from approximately THB 1,138 
million to THB 1,527 million, based on the 
pro-forma profit and loss statement for 
the period of June 1, 2026 -May 31,
